regressions.boundary: Verify result must match independently verified current snapshot
Policy evaluation cannot cross scope/qualification expiry before local commit
regressions.red_caveat: Regression first executed after root implemented fix; no separate observed-red claim.

regressions.boundary: Subsecond requested grant cannot silently disappear when another skill survives
Delayed old withdrawal cannot remove independently requalified grant

remaining_limitations: Real-service end-to-end adversarial and fresh-deployment gates belong to root/packaging, not this unit report.
Single-host immutable policy/fence guarantee requires trusted local host/configuration; not distributed authorization.

Authority service mutation and local lifecycle-event persistence are separate commits; crash between them can require authority reconciliation and leave incomplete transition evidence absent durable operation intent.
